Name: Land coverage
Description: The system shall image all land between 82° S and 82° N.

Name: Revisit
Description: Any point shall be revisited at least every 5 days.

Name: Ground sampling distance
Description:
Images shall resolve 4 m on the ground.

Measured at nadir.

Name: Same-day delivery
Description: 90 % of products shall be delivered within 6 hours.

Name: Emergency tasking
Description: During a disaster, an image shall be delivered within 24 hours of a request.

Name: Archive
Description: Products shall stay available for 10 years, including after the end of the mission.
